title: game/data/relations.json: the hub's folk and you (roguelite track RL-S2; logic/relations.js): what a gift costs and gives, each person's levels and what each level brings, and the favour each asks (the owner's numbers, 2026-10-26)

gift.description: a gift costs `cost` Beans and gives `points` (one gift a person each time you are home from a run); a favour done gives `favour`

people.description: by person id (people/<id>.json, or a lab keeper such as chosen): their levels, lowest first

favour.description: what they ask of you on a run (RL-S2 part B): a quest of story.json (stages asked, done; their ask line, a banter line, moves it to asked), the condition read on the way home that says it is done (most often on the run just ended: last:, lastteam:), the points it gives (else gift.favour)

at.description: the points it takes (rising level by level)

fx.description: effect rows on every run while you hold the level (logic/effects.js FX_KINDS, as a Perk's)

items.description: items into the bag at each takeoff while you hold the level

pyramids.description: pyramids at each takeoff while you hold the level

wardrobe.description: a wardrobe piece given once, when the level is reached (wardrobe.json)
